verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains only portal navigation labels (search, file, order copies) and account-mechanics help such as password reset and payment options. It has no plain-language, step-by-step explainers for founder tasks like forming or maintaining a business. The main sos.state.mn.us reading surface, where such guidance would likely live, was bot-walled and unobserved, so no first-party founder guidance is evidenced.

support.subject: As a founder, the service publishes plain-language, step-by-step guidance for my task — explainers a non-lawyer can follow, not just statute text and form numbers
